title: Backup Plans
summary: How will additional pipeline capacity impact tanker trades? When the US-Israeli war against Iran broke out, leading to the effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz (SOH), quick calculations showed that about 20 million barrels per day (Mb/d) of oil and oil products would be impacted. Many of the countries in the Middle East rely heavily on the SOH to export their crude oil and refined products.
